espn-604004.headline: After conceding 43 and 45, someone has to defend
beats: Scotland lost 21–43 to New Zealand at Murrayfield last weekend. Ewan Ashman scored a hat-trick, and the hosts did not score in the second half. Australia were beaten 22–45 by England at Twickenham the next day.

That was Australia's third straight defeat, after conceding 50 and 43 to New Zealand in October. Their last win was 42–38 over South Africa in September, so the attack exists. It is the other half that keeps going missing.

Sione Tuipulotu, Scotland's Australia-born captain, admits "that little bit of fire bubbling away whenever I play against the Wallabies." He also says the bigger motive is atoning for that second half against the All Blacks.

Australia have named a top-three finish in the southern conference as their target, and they sit three points short of it. Win, and they also go above Scotland into sixth in the world. Scotland won the previous Test between them, in 2024, 27–13. Neither side has defended like that lately.

espn-604005.headline: Beaten by Wales, New Zealand now get England
beats: Wales beat New Zealand 35-28 in Cardiff on 14 November, their first win over them since 1953. They scored five tries, turned down every shot at goal, and held New Zealand up over the line three times.
Richie Mo'unga started at fly-half with Damian McKenzie rested, and Planet Rugby rated him "abysmal". The captain, Beauden Barrett, was marked down for poor decisions alongside him.
England arrive on three straight wins, the latest 45-22 over Australia with seven tries. Beat New Zealand by 16 or more and they climb to third in the world, above Ireland and France.
Wales needed 305 tackles and 73 years. England did it at home last November, 33-19.

espn-604006.headline: Scotland score freely and concede more freely
beats: Scotland have conceded 38 or more in four of their last five Tests: 43 to Ireland, 42 to South Africa, 38 to Argentina and 43 to New Zealand. They scored seven tries in Argentina in July and still only won by nine.

Japan put 63 on USA and 57 on Canada in September. On 7 November they scored three tries in a 21–28 loss to Wales. Eddie Jones promised his youthful side would "play the house down" at Twickenham, and Scotland have not been hard to score against this year.

Warner Dearns, who turned down the All Blacks, leads a side with one win in five Nations Championship games and a points difference of -96. A Japan win by 15 or fewer would drop Scotland to seventh in the world, below Australia.
Japan have nothing scheduled after this. Scotland have Italy in February, which is a long time to watch the tape if Japan find the gaps everyone else has.

espn-604007.headline: Andrew Porter has waited a year for this scrum
beats: Porter has not played for Ireland since South Africa won 24–13 at the Aviva last November. Calf trouble cost him the Six Nations and the summer tour. The scrum that night cost Ireland ten penalties in the 12 that were not reset, plus five players carded, Porter among them.
South Africa arrive off a 21–19 defeat in Paris, after which Nick Mallett questioned Rassie Erasmus's late front-row switch. The front row, again.
Ireland come in off a 42–12 win over Argentina, Hugo Keenan scoring three tries. Win here and South Africa drop to second in the world, behind New Zealand.
Ireland stay third in the world whatever happens. The number Porter will be watching is the scrum count.

espn-604008.headline: Nine played, none won; the winner takes ninth
beats: Italy and Fiji are the bottom two in the Nations Championship, with one point between them from nine games. Italy have lost six straight, and the latest, 14–19 to Argentina in Genoa, got away from them in the final seconds.

That came a week after a 7–66 home loss to South Africa. Gonzalo Quesada said the first half against Argentina was where Italy had to crush them, and they were not ruthless. Fiji's last outing was a 17–54 loss in France.
Win in Udine and Italy climb from 11th to ninth, above Fiji and Wales. Fiji, the higher-ranked side, have more to lose.
Italy go to Scotland in February. Fiji's next game is Spain at home in the World Cup on 4 October 2027, a long time to sit on a loss to Italy.

espn-604009.headline: France's grand final place rests on a one-point lead
beats: France top the North by a single point from England, and only the North's top side reaches the grand final. They earned that point by beating South Africa 21–19 at the Stade de France, with Antoine Dupont playing scrum-half's role while wearing 10.
Argentina arrive steadier on paper than in practice. They lost 12–42 in Ireland, then held off Italy 19–14 in Genoa, in a game Italy had the means to win at the end.
The last meeting, in November 2024, went France's way 37–23. An Argentina win would also put England above France in the world rankings, which would make it a poor weekend twice over.
France's options at 10 have thinned all autumn, and a playmaker's return now eases that. The last man to wear the shirt was their scrum-half, and he did not look like he needed the help.

espn-604010.headline: Wales beat New Zealand. Australia lost to them twice
beats: Wales had lost 34 in a row to New Zealand before 14 November. They won 35–28 with five tries, turned down every shot at goal and made 305 tackles to keep the lead.
Australia arrive on three straight defeats. They conceded 50 and 43 to New Zealand in October, then 45 to England.
The rankings still put Australia three places higher. A Wales win would lift Wales to 9th and drop Australia to 8th, below Argentina.
Australia's next Test after this is Hong Kong at the World Cup in October 2027. A fourth straight defeat would have a long time to settle.
